library.name: Plotly.js
library.description: Renders every chart in this plugin family (Question Analytics, Solution Process Visualization, and the course-wide Analytics page) — vendored locally rather than loaded from a CDN so no student response data or chart content ever leaves the Moodle server's own network.

library.name: KaTeX
library.description: Client-side rendering of STACK/Maxima LaTeX (\( \), \[ \], and $ ... $ delimited math) in tables, question text, and notes — vendored locally for the same reason as Plotly.js above.
